in_sanskrit.name: Arjarth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave and valiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arjarth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arjarth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arj' meaning 'thunder' and 'dh' meaning 'giver'. It is a name of reverence and power, evoking images of strength, courage, and valiance. In Hindu mythology, Arjarth is the name of several revered figures, including the great hero Arjuna from the Mahabharata.
